```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)

library(tsibble)  
library(fable)   
library(feasts)

library(tseries)

library(ggfortify)

source("utils_for_group_project.R")
```

```{r data}
df_time <- read_csv("bike+sharing+dataset/day.csv")[, -1]

df_time_ts <- df_time %>%
  as_tsibble(index = dteday)

```



# Original Data
```{r y}
df_time_ts %>%
  autoplot(cnt, color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "The original Y",
  )

df_time_ts %>%
  model(
    classical_decomposition(cnt ~ season(7))
  ) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot()


df_time_ts %>%
  gg_season(cnt) +
  labs(
    title = "The original Y",
  ) # quadratic term


df_time_ts %>%
  ACF() %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(
    title = "ACF of Y",
  ) +
  df_time_ts %>%
  PACF() %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(
    title = "PACF of Y",
  )


df_time_ts$cnt %>%
  ts(start = c(2011, 01), frequency = 365) %>%
  adf.test()
```

```{r}
df_time_ts %>% 
  model(TSLM(cnt ~ trend() + I(trend()^2) + season())) %>% # linear with quadratic term
  report()

```

# Aggregated Monthly data
```{r}
monthly_df_time_ts <- df_time_ts %>%
  index_by(year_month = ~ yearmonth(.)) %>% # aggregate to monthly data
  summarise(cnt = sum(cnt))


monthly_df_time_ts %>%
  gg_season(cnt) +
  geom_point(size = 2)


monthly_df_time_ts %>%
  model(
    classical_decomposition(cnt ~ season(7))
  ) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "Decomposition")


monthly_df_time_ts$cnt %>%
  ts(start = c(2011, 01), frequency = 12) %>%
  adf.test()
```


# Model
```{r}
df_time_ts %>%
  model(ARIMA = ARIMA(cnt))


monthly_df_time_ts %>%
  model(ARIMA = ARIMA(cnt))
```


```{r}
df_time_ts %>%
  model(quad = TSLM(cnt ~ trend() + I(trend()^2) + season())) %>%
  forecast(h = "1 year") %>%
  autoplot(df_time_ts)
monthly_df_time_ts %>%
  model(quad = TSLM(cnt ~ trend() + I(trend()^2) + season())) %>%
  forecast(h = "1 year") %>%
  autoplot(monthly_df_time_ts)


monthly_df_time_ts %>%
  model(ARIMA = ARIMA(cnt)) %>%
  report()
```
